text:
maria_infra: FYI — WinterWave asked to bump their Dedicated commit for Dec 1 -> Jan 15. They want ~40% more GPU-hours for a promotional surge. Their current commit is 1200 GPU-hours/day; request is to cover ~1680 GPU-hours/day for 6 weeks. EU-West is pretty tight in that window. Need sizing + buffer policy call. @sam_sre any immediate blockers?

sam_sre: Can you share their historical hourly profile? p50/p95 concurrency? if p95 is spiky we should avoid naive uplift.

jess_infra: Quick snapshot from metrics: last 30 days rolling avg = 1200h/day, p95 daily = 1400h/day, peak rolling 24h = 1800h (one off). Their traffic pattern shows daily peaks around 16:00 UTC and short bursts (~1-2h).

kyle_fin: Cost delta if we grant full 40% committed uplift (1200 -> 1680): additional committed hours = 480h/day * 42 days = 20160 GPU-hours. At our committed rate that's ~ $151k extra for the period (rough calc). If we offer burst credits instead it's less predictable for us.

tara_sales: WinterWave is pushing hard — they say the campaign ROI is >2x and they can sign a 3mo extension if we help with buffer. They prefer committed uplift to avoid overage. Willing to accept a 10% discount on the incremental commit if we can do faster provisioning.

sanjay_net: Reminder — we have a planned network maintenance in eu-west on Dec 5 (ops-bot scheduled). That could reduce effective capacity by ~8-10% during the maintenance window. Link: https://internal.redwood/maint/ew1-dec5

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance notice: eu-west core switches will have rolling firmware updates on 2028-12-05 02:00-06:00 UTC. Impact: transient packet loss <2 min per rack.

maria_infra: Good catch. That maintenance overlaps early in campaign. We can shift their traffic to other regions for that 4h window, but need routing policy + capacity headroom elsewhere.

jess_infra: Proposed sizing playbook: baseline uplift = +20% committed (=> 1440h/day), buffer = +15% headroom for bursts, and an agreed burst-credit pool of 8% for the remaining spikes. So effective soft capacity ~ 1440 * 1.15 + burst = ~1835h/day peak-able. That covers typical p95 and occasional 24h peak.

kyle_fin: Financials for that plan: incremental commit = 240h/day * 42 = 10080h => ~$75k. Burst credits (8%) expected usage cost capping to maybe $8-12k if fully used. Net incremental revenue ~ $63-67k after discounted uplift.

sam_sre: Operational concerns: 1) EU-West margins are thin, can't shift more than 30% to us-east without impacting latency; 2) rolling canary for the routing change: route 10% -> us-east, monitor tail-latency for 2h, then step.

sanjay_net: I can add a fallback route in the smart-router policy: prefer eu-west, fallback to us-east with the following policy: if tail latency > 300ms for 2 consecutive minutes, move 25% traffic for 15 minutes. Will wire the policy and tests.

jess_infra: Automation checklist to stand up capacity: 1) reserve GPU pool in infra (dedicated pool tag: winterwave-2028), 2) prewarm KV caches for known prefixes, 3) enable prefix caching TTL=1h for campaign windows, 4) configure routing policy and canary. I can do steps 1-3; need net to push fallback rule.

tara_sales: If we do 20% commit + 15% buffer + 8% burst credits and guarantee uptime SLA 99.9% for campaign, WinterWave will sign the 3mo extension and agree to payment terms net30. They also asked for a post-campaign replay log for eval.

maria_infra: Decision call: Offer 20% committed uplift (1200->1440), 15% headroom buffer enforced by autoscaler, and an 8% burst-credit pool. Condition: routing fallback enabled, canary verification passed, and we exclude the eu-west maintenance window by routing cluster to us-east for the 4h. Tara — confirm commercial terms with customer (discount and extension).

tara_sales: Confirmed — will send term sheet with discount + extension.

sam_sre: I'll own the canary run on Dec 1 14:00 UTC. If metrics look good (tail latency, qps, error rate), we flip full routing.

jess_infra: I'll create infra runbook and capacity-reservation ticket: `infra/reserve winterwave-2028 pool size=1440h/day duration=42d buffer=15% burst=8%` and ping ops-bot for runbook link.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #INC-67214 reserved pool winterwave-2028. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/winterwave-2028

maria_infra: Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: @sanjay_net add the fallback rule and smoke tests; @kyle_fin finalize pricing sheet; @tara_sales get signed amendment before we provision.

sanjay_net: On it — I'll post test results in this thread once done. :white_check_mark:

jess_infra: Note: if we see >2x spikes vs historic peak we revert to full regional throttle — plan documented in runbook.

maria_infra: Closing note — target provisioning window: Dec 28-30 for capacity warm-up, canary Dec 1, full start Dec 1 (campaign start). We'll reconvene 1 day prior to canary for final checks.
